info.syllabusName: Art History_Lịch sử mỹ thuật VN &TG
info.timeAllocation:
Study hour (150h)
= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course provides knowledge of Art History: Through the course of Art History, students are equipped with the knowledge of the establishment circumstances, the development process, the specialties of the arts and famous artists of the World and Vietnam Fine Arts from primitive to modern.
The course also introduces typical art centers in Asia such as India, China and Japan to help students have an overview of the world's fine arts, especially outstanding artistic achievements. . ....

This course also provides some basic skills such as research methods, critical thinking, and mind mapping in the study of art history. In addition, this subject requires teamwork skills, oral presentation and paint skills in the process of assessment.
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
2. Actively participate in class activities
3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
5. Read the textbook in advance
6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

clos.loDetails: (Basic Knowledge) Summarize the development process of Art History; Identify and describe the major holdings related to fine art style and movement, avant-garde artists.
(Research Skills) - Understand the context of the major styles and movements in Art History, in relation to socio-cultural, economic, political, religious..., talented and avant-garde artists.
(Critical Thinking) Analyze and evaluate critically the meanings and descriptions of works of art from different periods of the past in Art History.
(Communication Skills): Study optional cases in Art History, organize and express the individual thoughts clearly and coherently both in orally (presentations) and writing (assignments/essays).
Be aware of what is aesthetics of visual art and understand the stages of aesthetic awareness in art history
Evaluate manual and/or digital art works, media and materials appropriately to produce creative ways solutions for specific cultural and technical contexts.
Having a professional style in arts activity. Love to research in art history.
Students have a proficient in presentation and teamworks.

assessments.gradingGuide:
Essay exercise: Each team choose a work, author, or period of art observed during an extracurricular activity to analyze and criticize to clarify the aesthetic value and characteristics of Vietnamese art.
Students are allowed to use AI tools during the assignment.

Formal Requirements – Museum Visit Essay
1. Length & Format

Length: 1200–1500 words (excluding references).
Format: Word or PDF.
Font: Times New Roman or Arial, size 12, line spacing 1.5.
Margins: A4 paper, 2.5 cm on all sides.
Page numbers: Bottom right corner.

2. Structure of the Essay
Title Page: Include the student’s full name, class, instructor’s name, course title, and submission date.
Introduction (≈10–15% of essay)
Body (≈70–75% of essay)
Conclusion (≈10–15% of essay)
References: Use APA 7th edition citation style (minimum of 3 scholarly sources, including books, journal articles, or reliable academic resources).

3. Academic Requirements
Proper in-text citations are used whenever ideas, data, or information are used.
No plagiarism (similarity < 20%).
The essay should demonstrate:
Knowledge of Vietnamese art.
Ability to analyze, compare, and evaluate.
Critical thinking and academic writing skills.

assessments.gradingGuide:
Option 1: 'Option 1: Individual exercise
Each student chooses a 20th-century art Style (e.g., Cubism, Surrealism, Abstract Expressionism, Pop Art, etc.). Then, take inspiration from the chosen style to create a new artwork (digital or hand-drawn).

Notes/Requirements:
- Explain the characteristics of the style: Describe the key characteristics, techniques, themes, and visual elements of the chosen style.
- Analyze your creative process: Clarify how you applied the chosen style to your work (e.g., composition, use of color, symbolism, technique).
- Use of AI-assisted tools is allowed: You may use AI to assist your creative process (e.g., creating references, visualizing concepts, experimenting with composition), but the final work must reflect your originality and critical judgment

Notes/Requirement
1. Description: Student groups (5-6 students in large groups or 2-3 students in small groups)
a. Use AI to create multiple-choice questions from the assigned chapters
● Number: 20–30 questions.
● Level distribution:
Recognition: about 9–13 questions. (name, time, place, author, work, style, material...)
Comprehension: about 9–14 questions. (stylistic characteristics, historical-social context, meaning of work, comparison of movements...)
Application/Analysis: about 2–3 questions (relating the work to the historical context, analyzing the influence of style, identifying style through images, explaining why the work is typical...)
b. Each question must have 4 answer options, and 1 correct answer is clearly marked.
c. Make sure the questions:
● Correct knowledge, closely follow the content of the assigned chapter, assigned documents
● Concise, clear, reasonable answers.
● Images used are in the document
